headings: The integrity engine for modern classrooms
Every layer of integrity, in one platform.
From blank slate to defensible grade.
A clear path from draft to released results.
Bring integrity back to every assessment.
text:
spend more time teaching, less time policing.

Try the workflow
01
Author a quiz in minutes

Create multiple-choice and short-answer questions, save a draft, then publish when the assessment is ready.

02
Distribute via secure code

Students enrol using a course code and enter a four-digit assessment code. The server checks assignments and availability.

03
Monitor in real time

Review submitted answers and recorded tab/focus or face-presence events before assigning a grade.

04
Analyze & defend grades

Save a private reviewed grade, explicitly release results, and export assessment marks.

AI INTEGRITY
Proctoring that respects students.

Face detection runs in the browser using face-api.js. Registration photos and numeric face descriptors are sent to the backend for identity verification. Assessment events are stored for teacher review; continuous video is not recorded.

Browser detection; identity descriptors stored on the backend
Event-only logs with timestamped rationale
Teacher-controlled camera monitoring per assessment
Auditable trail for every flagged moment

text:
QuizShield
INTEGRITY ENGINE

LEGAL

Privacy Policy

QuizShield is designed to collect the minimum information required to keep exams secure and support the learning experience.

Data we collect

QuizShield stores account and course details, quiz answers, reviewed grades, assessment events, registration photos and numeric face descriptors used for student identity verification.

How we use it

Face detection runs in the browser. Registration photos and descriptors are sent to the backend; continuous webcam video is not recorded. Verified teacher integrations can send schedules to Calendar and released results to Sheets.

Retention and access

Administrative data is retained for as long as the account or school deployment needs it, and access is limited to authorized users.

QuizShield
INTEGRITY ENGINE

LEGAL

Terms of Use

These terms describe the basic expectations for using the QuizShield platform in a school or training environment.

Authorized use only

Accounts should only be used by the teacher or student assigned to them, and exam credentials must not be shared.

Academic integrity

Students must follow the exam rules shown by their instructor, including webcam verification and proctoring checks.

Service availability

QuizShield is provided on a best-effort basis and may be updated or temporarily unavailable during maintenance.

SUPPORT

Contact

QuizShield support is usually handled through the institution that deployed the platform. The options below cover the most common ways to get help.

School administrator

Most QuizShield deployments are managed by your institution, so that is the first place to request help.

Instructor support

Teachers can review quiz activity, student status, and proctoring flags from their dashboard.

Account access

If you cannot sign in, use the password reset flow or ask your teacher to confirm your access.
